themes_detail.label: Street Deterioration Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints spiked to 36 this week versus a 9.5-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 279% increase (z-score: 4.3)—suggesting rapid pavement, pothole, or sidewalk degradation across CD 316 this week.
evidence: 36 street condition complaints this week vs. 9.5 weekly average (z-score: 4.3, 279% spike)
Concurrent spike in Root/Sewer/Sidewalk Condition complaints: 4 this week vs. 0.9 weekly average (357% increase)
408 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (265 alterations) suggest active construction that may be damaging streets
reporting_angles: Interview residents about specific locations with pothole/pavement damage; map complaints spatially
Investigate whether recent construction activity (408 permits, mostly alterations) is degrading street infrastructure without adequate repair

themes_detail.label: Garbage Collection Breakdown
themes_detail.summary: Missed collection complaints jumped to 11 last week versus a 1.4-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks—a 700% spike (z-score: 6.44)—indicating a potential citywide or district-specific sanitation service failure this week.
evidence: 11 missed collection complaints last week vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% spike, z-score: 6.44)
UNSANITARY CONDITION ranked 5th overall in 90-day complaints (538 total), likely linked to collection failures
Spike is statistically extreme (z-score 6.44) indicating systemic failure rather than isolated incidents
reporting_angles: Contact DSNY for explanation: staffing shortages, equipment breakdown, or route disruptions?
Document photographic evidence of uncollected waste on streets; interview residents about timing and frequency

themes_detail.label: Illegal Tree Damage Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints hit 4 three weeks ago versus a 0.2-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks—a 1500% spike (z-score: 8.66, highest statistical anomaly in dataset)—suggesting coordinated or repeated unauthorized tree removal or damage in CD 316.
evidence: 4 illegal tree damage complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average (1500% spike, z-score: 8.66—highest statistical anomaly)
Concurrent spike in Overgrown Tree/Branches: 3 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% increase, z-score: 3.77)
Two tree-related spikes suggest broader tree canopy management issue or contractor abuse
reporting_angles: Identify the 4 specific locations where illegal tree damage was reported; determine if same contractor/developer involved
Investigate whether development projects (Constellation CB16, 2111 Atlantic rezoning, Broadway Junction) are triggering unauthorized tree removals

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retail Complaint Spike
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints jumped to 7 last week versus a 1.6-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks—a 331% spike (z-score: 6.27)—suggesting new illegal dispensaries, compliance violations, or community opposition to recent retail openings in CD 316 this week.
evidence: 7 cannabis retailer complaints last week vs. 1.6 weekly average (331% spike, z-score: 6.27)
Spike occurred in a single week, suggesting acute trigger (new shop opening, operator complaint, enforcement sweep)
Statistically significant (z-score 6.27) indicates not random variation
reporting_angles: Identify which cannabis retailers opened recently in CD 316; check licensing and compliance status with OCM (Office of Cannabis Management)
Interview community residents and elected officials about specific complaints: illegal operations, odor, customer disorder, or zoning violations?

themes_detail.label: Sewer System Distress
themes_detail.summary: Sewer complaints spiked to 19 two weeks ago versus a 5.0-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks—a 280% increase (z-score: 5.6)—indicating potential sewage backups, overflow, or infrastructure failure affecting multiple blocks in CD 316.
evidence: 19 sewer complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 5.0 weekly average (280% spike, z-score: 5.6)
Related spike in Root/Sewer/Sidewalk Condition: 4 complaints last week vs. 0.9 average (357% increase)
WATER LEAK (282 complaints over 90 days) and PLUMBING (510) rank high overall, suggesting systemic water/sewer stress
reporting_angles: Request DEP data: are there known sewer main breaks, backups, or combined sewer overflows in specific neighborhoods?
Geotag the 19 complaints to identify if one area (e.g., near Constellation rezoning or Atlantic Avenue) is epicenter; interview affected households about sewage backup symptoms
